ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
 
  Pursuant to Indiana Code chapter 8-1-26, the Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) of t he 
Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission  (“Commission”) investigates excavation damage cases 
and makes find ings violations of said chapter. Upon review of those findings, the Indiana 
Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee  ( “Advisory Committee”) reviews those 
findings and recommends civil penalties in each case.   
 
Attached to this order are the cases received , with Division findings of violations and 
Advisory Committee recommendations, that are ripe for Commission action.   
 
The Commission hereby UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Division and 
APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the attached pages. The 
Office of General Counsel is directed to prepare and send notice to the parties advising them of 
the determination. 
 
Civil penalties approved by the Commission are due within 90 days of the date of this 
Order unless payment arrangements are made with the Commission’s Office of General Counsel.   
 
Trainings approved by the Commission must be completed no later than 90 days from the 
date of this Order unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Commissio n’s Office of General 
Counsel for good cause shown. Failure to complete the training results in the alternative civil 
penalty noted in the attached recommendation becoming due.   
 
IT IS SO ORDERED.

import sys, re, glob, os
from collections import defaultdict

files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(sys.argv[1], "*.txt")))
cases = []
for f in files:
    txt = open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    pages = re.split(r"^=== page.*$", txt, flags=re.M)
    for p in pages:
        if "Case Number" not in p:
            continue
        m_case = re.search(r"Case Number:\s*(\S+)", p)
        m_resp = re.search(r"Respondent:\s*(.+)", p)
        m_cite = re.search(r"finds the following violation\(s\):\s*\n\s*\n?\s*(IC[^\n]*)", p)
        m_pen = re.search(r"recommends the following civil penalty:(.*?)(Abstentions|Additional Information|APPROVED|$)", p, flags=re.S)
        cite = m_cite.group(1).strip() if m_cite else None
        pen_text = m_pen.group(1) if m_pen else ""
        # headline penalty: first $ amount
        headline = None
        m = re.search(r"\$+\s*([0-9][0-9,\s]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?)", pen_text)
        if m:
            s = re.sub(r"[,\s]", "", m.group(1))
            headline = float(s) if s else None
        else:
            headline = 0.0
        q = None
        if cite:
            mq = re.search(r"\(([A-Za-z][A-Za-z-]+)\)\s*$", cite)
            if mq:
                q = mq.group(1)
        cases.append(dict(file=os.path.basename(f), case=m_case.group(1) if m_case else None,
                          resp=m_resp.group(1).strip() if m_resp else None,
                          cite=cite, q=q, pen=headline, pen_text=pen_text.strip()[:80]))

print("cases:", len(cases), "files:", len(files))
for c in cases:
    if c["cite"] is None or c["resp"] is None or c["case"] is None:
        print("ANOMALY", c)
for qual in ["expire", "prior", "out"]:
    sub = [c for c in cases if c["q"] == qual]
    z = [c for c in sub if c["pen"] == 0]
    print(qual, len(sub), len(z), round(100*len(z)/len(sub),1) if sub else None)
print("qualifiers seen:", sorted(set(str(c["q"]) for c in cases)))
print("zero-penalty cases:", sum(1 for c in cases if c["pen"]==0))
print("no-$ penalties:")
for c in cases:
    if "$" not in c["pen_text"]:
        print(" ", c["file"], c["case"], c["cite"], repr(c["pen_text"][:60]))
EOF
